# DeepScreen

> DeepScreen is a stock screener and fundamental-analysis platform covering 13,055+ listings across five exchanges — NSE and BSE (India), NYSE and Nasdaq (US), and the LSE (UK). Each company gets a score from a 13-factor valuation and quality model, alongside live market news, an economic calendar, an IPO pipeline, options-strategy tools and a plain-English investing-education library.

Beyond the score, Pro users get a revised Graham intrinsic-value estimate, a DCF model and a moat/vision score for each company. DeepScreen is built for investors who find raw fundamental ratios hard to interpret — every metric is explained in plain English, not just displayed.

Important notes:

- Free vs. Pro: search, raw ratios, the IPO pipeline, news and the economic calendar are free. Verdicts, the Graham/DCF valuation models and alerts require Pro (₹50/week, ₹175/month, ₹1,800/year) — see [Pricing](https://deepscreen.online/pricing).
- Not investment advice: scores, verdicts and valuation output are analytical model output for research and education, not a recommendation to buy or sell.
- Individual company pages follow `/stock/{EXCHANGE}/{SYMBOL}`, e.g. [FLWS on Nasdaq](https://deepscreen.online/stock/NASDAQ/FLWS) or [20 Microns on the NSE](https://deepscreen.online/stock/NSE/20MICRONS). Valid exchange codes: NSE, BSE, NYSE, NASDAQ, LSE.
- Per-metric data sourcing is disclosed on each stock page; where a provider hasn't supplied a figure yet, the site shows a dash rather than a guess.

## Screeners

- [Cross-exchange screener](https://deepscreen.online/): All 13,055 listings with live price, the 13-factor score and verdict; filterable by exchange, sector, market cap and individual ratios.
- [NSE — National Stock Exchange of India](https://deepscreen.online/exchange/NSE): 2,297 companies, INR, IST, 09:15–15:30.
- [BSE — Bombay Stock Exchange](https://deepscreen.online/exchange/BSE): 5,123 companies, INR, IST, 09:15–15:30.
- [NYSE — New York Stock Exchange](https://deepscreen.online/exchange/NYSE): 2,032 companies, USD, ET, 09:30–16:00.
- [NASDAQ — Nasdaq Stock Market](https://deepscreen.online/exchange/NASDAQ): 3,232 companies, USD, ET, 09:30–16:00.
- [LSE — London Stock Exchange](https://deepscreen.online/exchange/LSE): 371 companies, GBP, GMT, 08:00–16:30.

## Analysis tools

- [Fundamental ratios](https://deepscreen.online/ratios): Plain-English explanation of each scoring ratio and how it's calculated.
- [Methodology](https://deepscreen.online/methodology): How the score, verdict, Graham intrinsic value, DCF and moat/vision score are derived, including data sources and known limitations.
- [Options strategies](https://deepscreen.online/options): 8 option-strategy signals with expiry breakevens and potential-loss modelling.
- [Economic calendar](https://deepscreen.online/calendar): Live-updating schedule of macro releases and earnings across the covered markets.
- [IPO calendar](https://deepscreen.online/ipo): Upcoming and recent IPOs across the five exchanges, with offering details and risk notes.
- [Portfolio & watchlists](https://deepscreen.online/portfolio): Save and track researched companies.
- [Pricing](https://deepscreen.online/pricing): Free-tier vs. Pro feature comparison and billing terms.
